hrv_evidence_search.most_relevant_finding: Schmidt 2018 (PMID 29472865, Front Physiol, cited 149x): 'Intracranial Pressure Is a Determinant of Sympathetic Activity.' Demonstrates in mice AND humans that ICP rise → sympathetic activation → HRV change. The effect is REVERSIBLE. Key quote: 'ICP is a REVERSIBLE determinant of efferent sympathetic outflow, even at relatively low ICP levels.'

K1_iih_specific_association.finding: No IIH-specific HRV study exists. The ICP→sympathetic→HRV pathway is established in general (Schmidt 2018) and in TBI (Mowery 2008, Fedriga 2021), but NOT in IIH specifically. The transfer from general ICP to IIH is plausible (IIH IS elevated ICP) but untested.

K2_causal_pathway_to_R2_C3.finding: Schmidt 2018 shows ICP→sympathetic is REVERSIBLE. If post-VSS ICP normalizes, sympathetic activity should reverse. In R2-C3 (ICP already normal), sympathetic activity should already be normal. HRV CANNOT distinguish R2-C3 (normal ICP + headache) from controls (normal ICP + no headache) — both have normal ICP and therefore should have normal sympathetic activity. The causal pathway undermines the R2-C3 hypothesis rather than supporting it.
K2_causal_pathway_to_R2_C3.key_quote: 'ICP is a REVERSIBLE determinant of efferent sympathetic outflow' — Schmidt 2018

K3_incremental_information.finding: If HRV is driven by ICP (Schmidt 2018: 'ICP is a DETERMINANT of sympathetic activity'), then HRV is a PROXY for ICP. Hakim already measures ICP. HRV would be a NOISIER VERSION of ICP, not an independent signal. This is the SAME PATTERN as CE-012: 'existing measurement + new purpose.' The frozen theorem applies again.
K3_incremental_information.key_insight: A signal can be GENUINELY ORTHOGONAL to a specific measurement architecture (Hakim measures pressure, not HRV) and still be a DOWNSTREAM CONSEQUENCE of the same physiological variable (ICP → sympathetic → HRV). Orthogonality to one architecture does not imply independence from the underlying physiology.

K4_decision_value.finding: If HRV is a proxy for ICP, then HRV-based decisions = ICP-based decisions. No new decision is enabled by HRV that ICP doesn't already enable.

K5_patent_prior_art.verdict: NOT TESTED — K2 and K3 already fail, making patent analysis moot

osv4_kill_verdict.candidate: OSV-4: HRV/autonomic state as orthogonal predictor for R2-C3
kill_reasons: K2 FAILS: The ICP→sympathetic pathway is REVERSIBLE (Schmidt 2018). If post-VSS ICP normalizes, sympathetic activity should normalize too. HRV cannot distinguish R2-C3 from controls.
K3 FAILS: HRV is a PROXY for ICP (Schmidt 2018: 'ICP is a determinant of sympathetic activity'). If ICP is already measured, HRV adds no new information. Same pattern as CE-012.
K4 FAILS: If HRV = proxy for ICP, no new decision is enabled.
osv4_kill_verdict.key_lesson: A signal can be GENUINELY ORTHOGONAL to a specific measurement architecture (different sensor, different physiological system) and still be a DOWNSTREAM CONSEQUENCE of the same underlying variable. Orthogonality to one architecture does not imply independence from the measured physiology. Before claiming a signal is 'new information,' test whether it is causally downstream of an already-measured variable.

CE_012_sharpened.old: 'AI + existing measurements is not enough. A world-class invention needs a genuinely new technical information source, transformation, or control capability.'
CE_012_sharpened.new: 'Existing information + existing transformation + existing control, merely recombined, is insufficient. A combination qualifies only if it produces a demonstrably new technical effect that survives prior art and non-obviousness attack. A world-class invention needs a genuinely new technical information source, transformation, or control capability. Do not build an AI layer on top of an already-claimed sensing/control architecture. NOTE: This theorem does NOT create a universal new sensor required rule. A novel combination of existing measurements CAN qualify if it produces a new, technically non-obvious effect. The theorem rejects TRIVIAL recombination, not all combinations.'

CE_013_new.lesson: A signal can be orthogonal to a measurement architecture and still be a downstream consequence of the measured variable. Test causal independence before claiming information independence.

verdict.article_v_compliance: The system is NOT a universal rejector. It killed 5 candidates with specific, documented reasons and extracted 2 reusable theorems. The kills are MECHANISM failures (the underlying physiology is already measured or is a downstream consequence), not implementation failures. A different problem territory may yield viable candidates.
verdict.article_xxxiv_compliance: The R2-C3 territory is EXHAUSTED at zero cost. All orthogonal variables either (a) fail the frozen theorem (existing measurement + new purpose), (b) are downstream consequences of already-measured variables, or (c) have no IIH evidence. The next bottleneck is REALITY (new clinical data or a different problem territory), not more computation.
next_moves: 1. PIVOT to a different problem territory. The R2-C3 phenotype predictor space has been exhausted. The reusable theorems (CE-012, CE-013) should be applied to new territories.

2. The R2-C3 phenotype ITSELF is real (3 confirmed cases in Ahmed 2011). The ontology (R2-C1 through R2-C5) remains FROZEN and valid. But the PREDICTOR architecture cannot produce a patentable invention at zero cost.

3. Per Article V: the kills do NOT mean the system is a universal rejector. They mean THIS TERRITORY (R2-C3 predictor) is exhausted. Other territories (e.g., different eShunt problems, different device capabilities) may yield viable candidates.
